ns2:section.sectionText: Course focuses on reading/understanding education research and doing a small education-related research project using publicly available data. Classes will initially be led by the instructor, but later will be conducted as a true seminar with students leading discussions on the topic of their research. To the extent possible, students will select readings and research topics of personal interest. This course is open to all College of Education students interested in undergraduate research. Student projects can then be entered in the Spring Campus Undergraduate Research Symposium.
